title: Analyte
purpose: Create or correct a measured substance/property and its optional CAS identifier. The edit form is also its record page.

sections.title: Fields and related work
paragraphs: Name and CAS number lock when work refers to an analyte’s definition. Analyte group stays editable with a reason. Policy-only references do not by themselves lock the analyte. There is no analyte availability checkbox; tests and method versions control availability.

items.label: Analyte name
items.description: Required, up to 160 characters, unique ignoring case. Surrounding spaces are removed.

items.label: CAS number
items.description: Optional, up to 30 characters. When present, numeric hyphenated format and check digit are verified; this does not verify chemical identity.

items.label: Analyte group
items.description: Optional, from a fixed list (for example Metals, Nutrients, Volatile organics, Microbiology); Not recorded leaves it blank. Filters the Analytes and Tests lists and groups related analytes. It describes the record only: it is not printed on reports and is not part of what locks when work depends on the record, so it stays editable with a reason.

items.label: View tests for this analyte
items.description: Edit-only link filters Tests to this analyte, when dependency facts are displayed.

sections.title: Saving and history
paragraphs: A record changed since opening cannot be overwritten. Submitted input remains on the error page; reload and compare current values before re-entering the intended change. Records are retained rather than deleted.

items.label: Create / Save changes
items.description: Only administrators submit. Creation is audited; an existing change records before/after values and requires a reason. An unchanged submission returns to the list with No changes to save and adds no edit event.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Existing records only: explain any changed value or availability decision.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the corresponding list without saving.

items.label: What depends on this
items.description: Counts referring records. Methods/analytes also show active tests out of all tests. These facts can include more dependencies than list work counts.

items.label: Locked values
items.description: Dependent identity values become read-only facts with lock reasons. Locks are rechecked when saving, including concurrent references.

items.label: History
items.description: The newest 20 audit events appear in chronological order with actor, timestamp and reason.
